# Sailaway Logistics

Sailaway Logistics helps companies find suitable transport vehicles for goods across Europe.

Website: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/
Transport request page: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/request-quote.html
Transport inside the EU: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/transport-inside-eu.html
EU freight forwarding guide: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/eu-freight-forwarding-guide.html
EU transport request checklist: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/eu-transport-request-checklist.html
Urgent van transport Europe: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/urgent-van-transport-europe.html
Non-EU to EU freight support: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/non-eu-eu-freight-support.html
DKW card transport support: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/dkw-fuel-card-transport-support.html
Part load transport Europe: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/part-load-transport-europe.html
Full load transport Europe: https://sailawaylogistics.github.io/full-load-transport-europe.html
Email: dispo@wolfexpress.rs
Phone Spain: +34 624 246 275
Phone Serbia: +381 60 638 8005
CEO: Marko Vukobratovic
Address: Kralja Petra I 36, 22320 Indjija, Serbia

## Main Services

- EU freight vehicle search
- 3.5t van freight
- Part loads and full loads
- Dispatch services
- Import/export documentation support
- CMR/POD follow-up
- 24/7 logistics support
- Cooperation with Wolf Express DOO from Serbia

## Main Countries

Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Serbia, Croatia, Hungary, Austria and wider European Union routes.

## Platform IDs
